tables.title: Moves
rows: Two lunging swings that each sweep a 150-degree arc in front of it、with a short forward dash just before each hit lands. Get behind it or well out of reach instead of sidestepping、and if the 秒ond swing misses、the heavy third hit never comes.
The third swing only follows when the 秒ond one connects、hitting for 30 with double the knockback of the first two. A long recovery follows it、the safest window to hit back in melee.

Once you're out of swing range it winds up、then barrels at you for up to 3 秒onds with the strongest knockback in its kit. It turns very slowly mid-run、so sidestep late rather than running straight away.
The charge ends in a body slam that hits for 35 with 5 splash damage around the impact、and the hit can be sidestepped. The landing spot becomes a slowing moss patch that lasts 2.5 秒onds.

It slams both fists into the ground for 15 damage around its hands、and half a 秒ond later three flowers erupt at your feet. Move off the spot at once: each flower bursts just over a 秒ond later into a large poison puddle、though at 20 health they can also be broken.

At range it fires up to three volleys of seeds from its back (8、then 6、then 4)、each slower、shorter than the last、and every seed leaves a poison puddle where it lands. The seeds don't home、so keep strafing、then close in during the recovery after the last volley.
Flowers keep sprouting along its path as it moves、up to ten at a time. Get near one、it bursts into a poison puddle after just over a 秒ond、but each has only 20 health、so break the ones in your way.
With a roar it calls 5 to 11 Moss Cubes into the arena、never more than 15 alive at once. It tries this after a seed barrage or when nothing else is ready、and each summoned cube is worth 20 souls.
